properties.name: Pre-reaction pi complex of two cyclopentadiene molecules (endo approach, syn face relation)
properties.note: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP gas phase, combined Opt+Freq, 0 imaginary frequencies (60 real modes); two intact Cp rings, ring centroids 3.78 A, forming pairs C2...C7 3.39 A and C4...C6 3.44 A.

properties.name: Concerted endo [4+2] transition state
properties.note: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP gas phase Opt=TS + Freq; exactly one imaginary frequency at -473.31 cm-1; at the saddle both new C-C bonds are the two shortest inter-fragment contacts (2.10 and 2.39 A) and the three diene C-C bonds are 1.400-1.415 A.

properties.name: endo-Dicyclopentadiene (tricyclo[5.2.1.0(2,6)]deca-3,8-diene)
properties.note: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP gas phase, combined Opt+Freq, 0 imaginary frequencies; endo (syn) diastereomer, diene-CH2...dienophile-CH2 = 3.12 A.
